correctness.rationale: The original quadrature tail has weights 23/12, 7/12 then 1 with three left-end corrections. Subtracting q times the preceding recurrence, q=e^{-theta}, cancels the starting convolution forcing and produces the displayed quartic with K=mu beta theta. At v=beta theta q(23-16q+5q²)/(12(1-q)), P(1)=6mu(1-q)(1-v); v>1 forces a real root>1. For v<1, the Cayley transform maps Schur to Hurwitz and seven necessary/sufficient Routh–Hurwitz expressions have explicit strictly positive polynomial numerators after q=X/(1+X),v=Y/(1+Y); independent rational SymPy reconstruction verified all coefficients nonnegative and exact term counts 3,14,16,16,16,63,117, plus all five v=1 boundary positivity checks. A separate expansion of theta W(e^{-theta}) proves <1 for theta>0, and the continuous augmented 2x2 memory ODE has a positive eigenvalue whenever beta>1. The verifier checks algebraic positivity for all positive parameters, not mere sampling.
residual_risks: The finite computations alone do not establish unrestricted hypotheses, parameter domains or infinite quantifiers; proof reconstruction supplies those steps.
